paragraphs.text: Precise diagnostics, individual medicine and naturopathic approaches lay the foundation for long-term health and support healthy ageing.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Your stay therefore follows no rigid programme. Your personal state of health sets the direction.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: That is why we always consider medical findings in the context of your individual way of life and further areas of your health.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Because sometimes the decisive insight lies not in a single value, but in the interplay of different factors.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: For us, naturopathy does not mean replacing modern medicine. Both approaches can complement each other meaningfully.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Depending on your individual situation, modern medical procedures can be combined with nutritional therapy, medicinal plants, movement, regeneration and further naturopathic applications.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: The decisive question is not which medical school takes precedence. What matters is which diagnostic and therapeutic options make sense for you.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: A key idea of naturopathy is to support the body's own processes of regulation and regeneration.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: This approach is reflected in many areas of the Lanserhof Concept.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Conscious nutrition can relieve digestion. Movement sets targeted stimuli. Sleep supports regeneration. Calm and nature create distance from everyday life. Mental health and stress regulation compleme
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: We understand these elements not as individual measures, but as parts of a medically guided overall concept.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Modern diagnostics play an important role in the Lanserhof Concept.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Depending on the location and the medical question, different diagnostic procedures can be used to capture your state of health more precisely and to detect possible risks or irregularities early.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: For us, technology is never an end in itself. What matters is which insights emerge from it and how they can be used for your health.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Modern diagnostics thus serve to look more closely, to understand connections better and to make medical decisions individually.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Health does not only mean treating existing complaints. It also means detecting possible risks early and understanding one's own body better.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Here modern medicine and naturopathy complement each other particularly well.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Diagnostics create clarity about the current state of health. Nutrition, movement, sleep, regeneration and further factors at the same time open up ways to actively support your own health in everyday
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Prevention thus becomes an essential part of the Lanserhof Concept.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Your personal therapy and health plan emerges from diagnostics and medical assessment.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Depending on your starting point, different priorities can be set. Nutrition & Fasting can be part of it, as can movement, medical or naturopathic applications, stress regulation and targeted regenera
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: What matters is not the number of measures, but their interplay.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: During your stay, your medical team accompanies you and, where needed, adapts the health plan to your progress and your individual needs.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: For us, naturopathy also means placing fundamental human needs back at the centre.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Natural nutrition, movement, daylight, sleep, calm and time in nature can be important foundations for health and regeneration.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: At Lanserhof we combine these natural principles with the knowledge and possibilities of modern medicine.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: The result is an approach that does not look back to the past, but brings medical precision and natural principles of health together in a meaningful way.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Whether you are planning your first stay or returning to a programme you know well: our reservation team knows every resort personally and takes the time to find the dates, programme and room that fit
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

Medicine &
NATUROPATHY

Precise diagnostics, individual medicine and naturopathic approaches lay the foundation for long-term health and support healthy ageing.

Understanding you.
SUPPORTING YOUR HEALTH.

Modern medicine today makes it possible to detect changes early and to understand the connections within our health ever more precisely. At the same time, health is more than individual readings, organs or symptoms.

Nutrition, movement, sleep, stress and regeneration influence our wellbeing just as much. That is why at Lanserhof we combine modern medicine and naturopathy into one holistic medical approach.

Understand first.
THEN TREAT.

For us, everything begins with a precise understanding of your individual state of health.

The same complaints can have different causes. That is why we look not only at individual symptoms, but ask how different factors interact and what your body needs.

Medical diagnostics and the personal consultation with your physician form the foundation. From the findings, your individual therapy and health plan emerges.

Your stay therefore follows no rigid programme. Your personal state of health sets the direction.

Seeing the person
AS A WHOLE

High-tech diagnostics and medical expertise help us to capture your state of health in a differentiated way. Proven naturopathic methods as well as Nutrition & Fasting, movement and regeneration complete this view.

Modern medicine is highly specialised and allows a very precise view of individual areas. At the same time, metabolism, digestion, the immune system, nutrition, movement, sleep and mental strain can be closely interlinked.

That is why we always consider medical findings in the context of your individual way of life and further areas of your health.

Because sometimes the decisive insight lies not in a single value, but in the interplay of different factors.

Combining modern medicine
AND NATUROPATHY

For us, naturopathy does not mean replacing modern medicine. Both approaches can complement each other meaningfully.

Depending on your individual situation, modern medical procedures can be combined with nutritional therapy, medicinal plants, movement, regeneration and further naturopathic applications.

The decisive question is not which medical school takes precedence. What matters is which diagnostic and therapeutic options make sense for you.

Supporting the body's
NATURAL RESOURCES

A key idea of naturopathy is to support the body's own processes of regulation and regeneration.

This approach is reflected in many areas of the Lanserhof Concept.

Conscious nutrition can relieve digestion. Movement sets targeted stimuli. Sleep supports regeneration. Calm and nature create distance from everyday life. Mental health and stress regulation complement the medical view.

We understand these elements not as individual measures, but as parts of a medically guided overall concept.

Precise diagnostics
FOR TARGETED DECISIONS

Modern diagnostics play an important role in the Lanserhof Concept.

Depending on the location and the medical question, different diagnostic procedures can be used to capture your state of health more precisely and to detect possible risks or irregularities early.

For us, technology is never an end in itself. What matters is which insights emerge from it and how they can be used for your health.

Modern diagnostics thus serve to look more closely, to understand connections better and to make medical decisions individually.

Prevention
BEGINS EARLY

Health does not only mean treating existing complaints. It also means detecting possible risks early and understanding one's own body better.

Here modern medicine and naturopathy complement each other particularly well.

Diagnostics create clarity about the current state of health. Nutrition, movement, sleep, regeneration and further factors at the same time open up ways to actively support your own health in everyday life.

Prevention thus becomes an essential part of the Lanserhof Concept.

Therapy
IS INDIVIDUAL

Your personal therapy and health plan emerges from diagnostics and medical assessment.

Depending on your starting point, different priorities can be set. Nutrition & Fasting can be part of it, as can movement, medical or naturopathic applications, stress regulation and targeted regeneration.

What matters is not the number of measures, but their interplay.

During your stay, your medical team accompanies you and, where needed, adapts the health plan to your progress and your individual needs.

Reconnecting nature
AND MODERN MEDICINE

For us, naturopathy also means placing fundamental human needs back at the centre.

Natural nutrition, movement, daylight, sleep, calm and time in nature can be important foundations for health and regeneration.

At Lanserhof we combine these natural principles with the knowledge and possibilities of modern medicine.

The result is an approach that does not look back to the past, but brings medical precision and natural principles of health together in a meaningful way.
